items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Everytime she'd come visit us, she'd always bring me a nickle

ctx.x: Anderson Autrey, that's right. And Minerve. My grandmother, she was a very sweet woman. I don't know, I always loved her. Everytime she'd come visit us, she'd always bring me a nickle, she'd reach in her pocket...evidently, she didn't have but just one, because that was the black-est nickel I had ever seen. I said this can't be any good. I'd look at it and shine it up til I'd get to the candy store. It was alright (laugh).
